family.description: This is the N-terminal domain of tRNA-queuosine alpha-mannosyltransferase (QTMAN, also known as GTDC1) from animals. QTMAN is a glycosyltransferase that specifically catalyses mannosylation of cytoplasmic tRNA(Asp) modified with queuosine at position 34 (queuosine(34)) to form mannosyl-queuosine(34) [[cite:PUB00153407]]. Mannosylation of queuosine(34) in tRNA(Asp) is required to slow-down elongation at cognate codons GAC and GAU, thereby regulating protein translation [[cite:PUB00153407]]. This domain is about 170 amino acids in length and adopts a Rossmann-fold. This domain is found associated with [pfam:PF00534] found at the C-terminal. This domain has two conserved sequence motifs: HENQ and FNS and it also has a single completely conserved residue S that may be functionally important. This domain is also found in uncharacterised bacterial sequences.
family.name: tRNA-queuosine alpha-mannosyltransferase N-terminal
